posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
@DeterminedKid1000
Since there was a lot of "Panic" going on in this topic, I think it is best if I point out what the original problem was and how I always remember that when eventing:
Page order is extremely important for events
and
Highest page number has highest priority
basically only one page of an event can be active, and if several pages have all their conditiones fulfilled or cleared, then the page with the highest number will be active.
In your original case, the second page had no conditions - which means that it will always take priority over the first page, no matter what.
That is why your switch didn't work correctly

Just a general note, but the way the program reads stuff is that the most recent page is read first, if the conditions for it are met. So you want to put your switch based pages later on, rather than the start.
Since your conditions on page 2 or 3 were met, while also the condition on page 1, the program was reading pages 2/3 as the are more recent pages.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
small tip to you if you want to show issue.
here is a small debug tip to see if it is triggered.
under switch = ON, use a scriptcall:
console.log("switch x: ", $gameSwitches.value(n))
change x to your switch (optional), replace N with the ID number.
this way, you can see if its ON  (true) as it should be or OFF (false)
if it fails.
from there, you can see what you miss (action trigger, item, whatever
supposed to happen.
